Calendar verification

The departmental timetable supplied by the instructor covers September 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027 (Weeks 1-16). The university calendar confirms that teaching starts on September 14.

  • First regular class: Tuesday, September 15, 2026.
  • National Day holiday: October 1-7. October 6 is excluded from the regular teaching dates.
  • Mid-Autumn Festival: September 25. It does not fall on a regular Tuesday meeting.
  • New Year: January 1, 2027. It does not fall on a regular Tuesday meeting.
  • Last regular class in this timetable: December 29, 2026. January 5 and 12 have not been added as course meetings.
Makeup class still pending. The university's holiday teaching adjustment notice was listed on September 14, 2026, but its full text requires Tsinghua sign-in. National working-day adjustments alone do not establish a university makeup class.

The downloadable calendar contains the 15 regular meetings only. Re-download it after any teaching adjustment is confirmed. No final-exam date has been inferred.
